The '''Turbolaser II''' was a type of heavy [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] emplacement manufactured by [[Golan Arms/Legends|Golan Arms]], used to protect a variety of military compounds and fortress from [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] attacks. It drew power from a dedicated power generator and required a crew of three to operate, although if incapacitated the weapon could also be controlled from a central command center.<ref name="HS" />
